hydraulicModel.assetStrategy: time-based one-hour crest release over precomputed one-foot-grid hydraulic lookups

scenarioMethod: Mean uses NOAA TWL90p minus 0.25 ft before dated tide anchoring. Minimum is two inches below the final Mean, except for explicitly dated Minimum tide anchors fitted between unchanged low tides. Maximum retains the existing normal lower-tail p25 estimate minus 0.25 ft. NOAA bias is retained and raw NOAA forecasts are preserved separately.
meanTideAnchorMethod: Dated manual Mean crests in feet MLLW. Each rise and fall is scaled about its adjacent low tide; peak times and low tides are preserved. Minimum follows two inches below Mean except its dated tide overrides. Maximum is unchanged.
